operational_mode: offline/DEV only (no Cscape GUI, no PLC, no hardware)

test_execution.coverage: 100% of cataloged false-success vulnerabilities across 28 negative test cases

CASE_01.name: cscape_run_simulation - Empty Simulation Loop
CASE_01.vulnerability: Empty or None st_code returned status: success and success: True on 0 POUs.
CASE_01.fix: Fail closed on empty or whitespace st_code: status='failed', error_code='INVALID_ST_CODE'.

CASE_02.name: cscape_inspect_variables - Success on Missing Project / Broken POUs
CASE_02.vulnerability: Non-existent project or missing pous dir returned status: success with 0 variables.
CASE_02.fix: Validate project_name via SafetyGuard.validate_project_name(); fail closed if missing: status='failed', error_code='PROJECT_NOT_FOUND'.

CASE_03.name: cscape_insert_st & cscape_add_st_pou - Missing POU Name Validation
CASE_03.vulnerability: Unsanitized pou_name allowed traversal or empty POU names while reporting success: True.
CASE_03.fix: Enforced SafetyGuard.validate_pou_name() and pou_type validation at entry.

CASE_04.name: cscape_write_variables - Success on Empty Variable List
CASE_04.vulnerability: Writing 0 variables returned success: True, written_count: 0.
CASE_04.fix: Fail closed if total_count == 0: status='failed', error_code='EMPTY_VARIABLE_LIST'. Enforce success = (is_valid and total_count > 0).

CASE_05.name: cscape_read_variables - Success on Empty Database or Path
CASE_05.vulnerability: Empty variables file with 0 records returned success: True.
CASE_05.fix: Require non-empty file_path; fail closed if count == 0: status='failed', error_code='EMPTY_VARIABLE_DATABASE'.

CASE_06.name: cscape_get_build_output - Hardcoded success: True on Failed Build
CASE_06.vulnerability: Dict explicitly set success: True while setting status: failed on build error.

CASE_07.name: cscape_get_diagnostics - Compile Successful & Clean Build Overrides
CASE_07.vulnerability: Defaulted compile_successful to True, clean_build hardcoded to True, empty project defaulted to cwd.
CASE_07.fix: Reject empty project name; set clean_build = bool(compile_ok and warning_count == 0 and error_count == 0).

CASE_08.name: get_active_simulator - Non-Existent Project Execution
CASE_08.vulnerability: Non-existent project bypassed POU/variable loading and returned running simulator on 0 POUs.
CASE_08.fix: Raise FileNotFoundError when specified project directory does not exist.

CASE_09.name: cscape_simulate_pou - Mock Fallback Masking Execution Errors
CASE_09.vulnerability: Runtime simulation exception fell back to mock evaluator that returned success: True without error.
CASE_09.fix: Wrap fallback in try-except; fail closed with status='failed', error_code='SIMULATION_EXECUTION_ERROR'.

CASE_10.name: STParser.validate - Empty Code Validated as Valid
CASE_10.vulnerability: Empty or whitespace-only source emitted a warning but returned is_valid=True.
CASE_10.fix: Emit IssueSeverity.ERROR with code ERR_EMPTY_SOURCE and return is_valid=False.

CASE_11.name: com_bridge.py open_project - Returncode Bypass
CASE_11.vulnerability: Condition 'or timed_out is False' caused abnormal process exits (returncode != 0) to report status: success.
CASE_11.fix: Condition updated to 'returncode == 0 and not timed_out'.

CASE_12.name: cscape_export_project - Synthesis of Dummy Files on Missing Artifacts
CASE_12.vulnerability: Generated synthetic .k5p dummy files on missing projects and reported status: success.
CASE_12.fix: Fail closed if source file does not exist: status='failed', error_code='NO_DATA_TO_EXPORT'.

CASE_13.name: normalize_tool_result - Unverified Result Dict Defaults to Success
CASE_13.vulnerability: Dict omitting both status and success fell through to status='success', success=True.

CASE_14.name: Convenience Tools - Non-Canonical 'error' Status
CASE_14.vulnerability: Tools assigned status: 'error' violating canonical 4-state contract.
CASE_14.fix: Replaced 'error' with canonical 'failed' across all tool failure return branches.

CASE_15.name: CscapeLiveProjectManager.open_project - Fake Open Without Live Engine
CASE_15.vulnerability: Checked stale gate JSON for is_project_open without checking if PID/HWND is actually live.
CASE_15.fix: Require IsWindow / process liveness check before trusting gate JSON.

CASE_16.name: cscape_new_iec_project - Live GUI Failure Fallback to Dummy CFBF
CASE_16.vulnerability: Swallowed live GUI failure with warning and generated synthetic CFBF bytes with success: True.
CASE_16.fix: Fail closed if live GUI creation was requested and fails: status='failed', error_code='LIVE_PROJECT_CREATION_FAILED'.

CASE_17.name: StructuredTextInserter - AST Hash Crash Defaulting ast_match to True
CASE_17.vulnerability: If AST hash calculation crashed, expression defaulted to True, bypassing AST verification.
CASE_17.fix: Require ast_match without defaulting to True on failure; fail closed.

CASE_18.name: STSimulator._evaluate_expression - Swallowing Runtime Evaluation Exceptions
CASE_18.vulnerability: Eval exceptions (e.g. ZeroDivisionError) returned raw unparsed string and reported success: True.
CASE_18.fix: Raise RuntimeError on eval failure; catch in simulate() and fail closed with error_code='SIMULATION_EXECUTION_ERROR'.

CASE_19.name: cscape_compile & normalize_tool_result - Build Warnings Coerced to Success
CASE_19.vulnerability: BuildStatus.WARNINGS or status 'warnings' mapped to status='success' if errors_list was empty.

CASE_20.name: intercept_hardware_interface - Port Lockout Bypass on Empty interface_name
CASE_20.vulnerability: Early return on empty interface_name bypassed evaluation of port parameter.
CASE_20.fix: Evaluate interface_name and port independently; fail closed on blocked port.

CASE_21.name: test_real_compilation.py - Synthetic Win32 Mocks Claiming Live Pass
CASE_21.vulnerability: Unit tests using canned mock HWND 99999 could be misinterpreted as live Cscape passes.

CASE_22.name: IECValidator.validate - Swallowing Semantic Parser Exceptions
CASE_22.vulnerability: Unexpected STParser.validate exception was swallowed with pass, dropping diagnostics.
CASE_22.fix: Catch exception and append diagnostic to warnings list.

CASE_23.name: cscape_validate_st - Empty Code & Ladder Logic Rejection
CASE_23.vulnerability: Empty source or ladder logic could be accepted without explicit fail-closed contract.
CASE_23.fix: Reject empty ST code and reject ladder logic with ERR_LADDER_FORBIDDEN; fail closed with valid=False, status='failed'.

CASE_24.name: cscape_compile - Missing Project & Ladder Logic Syntax Rejection
CASE_24.vulnerability: Compiling non-existent directory or ladder logic POU could produce ambiguous statuses.
CASE_24.fix: Fail closed on missing project (PROJECT_NOT_FOUND) and ladder logic POU (ST_SYNTAX_ERROR).

CASE_25.name: cscape_compile_project - Empty Project Name Validation
CASE_25.vulnerability: Convenience compile wrapper on empty string could attempt directory resolution against workspace root.
CASE_25.fix: Validate project name; fail closed immediately with status='failed'.

CASE_26.name: cscape_read_register - Malformed Address & Non-Existent Project Rejection
CASE_26.vulnerability: Reading malformed register syntax or non-existent project could return ambiguous defaults.
CASE_26.fix: Fail closed with ERR_INVALID_REGISTER_ADDRESS or project error; status='failed'.

CASE_27.name: cscape_write_register - Malformed Address & Non-Existent Project Rejection
CASE_27.vulnerability: Writing malformed register syntax or non-existent project could return ambiguous success.
CASE_27.fix: Fail closed with ERR_INVALID_REGISTER_ADDRESS or project error; status='failed'.

CASE_28.name: cscape_simulate_cycle & Variable Import/Export Fail Closed
CASE_28.vulnerability: Simulating non-existent project or importing/exporting empty variable sets could return false success.
CASE_28.fix: Fail closed with status='failed' on non-existent project or empty variable sets.
